entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Wilhelm Isak Wolf Ritter von Gutmann was an Austrian entrepreneur. He founded and led the largest coal company in Austria-Hungary, was nobilitated in 1878 and was President of the Vienna Israelite Community from 1891 to 1892.
